<page>
 Cooper & Quinn LLP
 Pasadena, TX
 Phone 832-555-2058
 Settlement Demand
10/24/2023
Claims Department
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Re: Claim C-1317 - Demand for settlement
Dear Claims Representative:
Our office represents Michael Gilbert in connection with the motor vehicle collision
that occurred on 03/26/2023. Our client was driving within the posted limit when
another vehicle crossed into their lane and struck them head-on. The impact was at low
speed, but it was enough to cause a sudden jolt through the body and to leave our
client with neck and back strain.
Since the collision, our client has experienced persistent neck stiffness, lower back
pain, and headaches that interfere with sleep and with ordinary daily tasks. Our
client has followed the treatment plan recommended by their physician, including
physical therapy and prescribed medication, and continues to attend appointments.
Records documenting the diagnosis, the course of care, and the associated costs are
enclosed for your review.
The facts of how the collision happened are not in serious dispute. Your insured's
vehicle crossed the centerline, and liability rests with your insured. We therefore
ask that you evaluate this claim promptly and in good faith.
Our client will accept $213,000.00 in full settlement of all claims arising from this
collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If
we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file
suit without further notice.
Expert review: Curtis James, biomechanical engineer
Sincerely,
Matthew Day
Cooper & Quinn LLP
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
